Stand up Claude Code
as a development harness.

One template that carries a requirement note through PRD, design, task breakdown, implementation and review. Instructions, skills, subagents, guardrails and a validation gate arrive together and work as soon as they are copied. Nothing here is tied to a language or a framework.

View the repository Install in five lines Read the README

It starts with a single requirement note

The skills have a defined order, with five quality gates where a human can stop and correct the work. You do not have to use all of them. One skill on its own is a valid way to start.

1
/brainstorm

Socratic questions that give a vague request its shape. Read-only.

2
/prd

Turns the note into a PRD. Specification first, technology later.Gate 1

3
/architecture

System structure and the allowed direction of dependencies.Gate 2

4
/plan

Breaks the design into tasks and fixes the order of work.Gate 3

5
/implementing-features

Test-driven implementation. It also owns the docs and config updates.Gate 4

6
/code-review /security-scan

Verification in a fresh context. End-to-end tests, performance and legal checks sit at the same level.Gate 5

Design choices

Each one turns something you want the model to honour into a mechanism rather than a paragraph.

Separate human and AI ownership

Decisions a person must make live in one file. Documentation and deliverables are generated and maintained by the model. The boundary stays explicit.

Enforce instead of instruct

Anything that must hold every time becomes a hook. Three layers of defence: hooks and sandbox, deny and ask, then allow. Secrets cannot even be read.

Give the work places to stop

Five quality gates, plus a hook that catches a session ending with source edits that were never verified.

Do not burn the context

The instruction file stays under 200 lines. Skills read detail only when they need it, and the listing stays inside its budget.

Keep expected behaviour as tests

Every skill ships evals. The same request runs with and without the skill, and an agent that did not produce the output grades it.

Break it and CI fails

The harness validates itself: settings outside the official spec, references that do not resolve, and drift between the two mirrors.

Install

Clone the repository and run the setup script once. There is no plugin distribution, on purpose.

git clone https://github.com/froggugugugu/project-blueprints.git
cd project-blueprints
bash project-blueprint-en/setup.sh /path/to/your-project   # Japanese: project-blueprint/setup.sh

cd /path/to/your-project
claude
ProfileWhat you getGood for
--profile minimal5 skills, 2 subagents, 2 hooksTrying it out, or adding the smallest useful piece to an existing project
--profile standardAll skills, subagents and hooks, no teams or workflowsRunning the whole lifecycle solo
--profile full (default)EverythingUsing the multi-agent formations as well

Three entries are enough to start

## §1. Project Basics
Name: MyApp
Summary: Internal inventory management

## §2. Tech Stack
- Python 3.13 / FastAPI

## §3. Commands
- test: pytest
- lint: ruff check .

The remaining ten sections can stay empty. Fill them in when a skill needs them.

Validation

A harness configuration fails quietly when it fails at all, so this one is checked deterministically, without an LLM. Run it before committing anything under .claude/. CI runs the same command. 

bash scripts/validate-harness.sh            # both mirrors and their structural parity
bash scripts/validate-harness.sh --test     # negative tests for the validator itself
bash scripts/validate-harness.sh --hooks    # functional tests for the hooks
bash scripts/validate-harness.sh --online   # resolve the npm packages in the MCP config
  • Settings that drift from the official spec.Frontmatter values and permission rules the runtime never consults
  • References that do not exist.Hook scripts, import targets, and links into reference files
  • Writing that wastes context.Skill body length, description budget, and line-start load directives
  • Eval and workflow format.Schema, declaration shape, and calls that would break determinism
  • Principles and mirror parity.The hash of the constitution file and the file layout of both mirrors
